entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable. The quality is a joke and your company should be ashamed.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
A preference issue? I ordered my size and this thing is way too tight! I can't even zip it up. It's clearly the wrong size. Don't try to blame this on me. This is your company's fault.
I understand your frustration completely. It's definitely disappointing when an item doesn't fit as you expect. I can certainly help you with a return or an exchange.

You better. I've had it for a little while now and if you give me some garbage excuse about a time limit, I'm going to file a complaint and light you up on every review site on the internet. Get me your manager, now.
There's no need for a manager, sir, I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Let me just pull up our return policy. Can I get your order number, please?
Fine. It's VF9876543. And this is your last chance before I start screaming.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the ClubFit Jersey, delivered 47 days ago. And let me check our policy... Yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you immediately.
Wait, really? You're just... going to approve it? No hassle?

Yes, of course. I'm sorry for the trouble you've had. We can either process a full refund back to your original payment method, or I can set up an exchange for a larger size if you'd like to try that.
Just... give me the refund. I'm done with this. Send me the label.

Not a problem. I have just initiated the return process. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
